Claim: PM loop round 1 (maintainer direct dispatch)
Session: `local_6eb9ec2e-0e3f-410b-9123-9dab7a337b9e` (the maintainer's local session, as PM); the developer is a cloud Claude Code session titled "p0 #23904: installed pages must not brick kernels"
Account: `hotlong` (the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23904-load-tolerance`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23904` (cloud session)
Domain: `domain:spec` (the refusal lives in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` and its load path; triage may re-route)
Seat: not a registered seat: the maintainer's local executor acting as PM on the maintainer's order
File surface: the load-time path of the page checks `a69a40a572` added (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` and where the kernel or metadata loader applies them), their tests, one `.changeset/*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, top tier
Clause-②: yes (a refusal at load becomes a named warning; authoring and publish doors unchanged)
Responsibility: `a69a40a572` is this repository's | no platform path loads an installed package that predates it | every hosted environment with HotCRM 4.0.1 installed (10 staging, 5 production) fails its kernel build (measured on staging)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: none known on the page schema's load path

Maintainer's orders (2026-10-16, local session, verbatim): the option 「两条都做」 (this card is its framework half) · 「在 objectstack-ai/objectstack 开云端会话处理 #23904」.

Release: the claim above (`local_6eb9ec2e…`, branch `claude/issue-23904-load-tolerance`) is withdrawn before any developer started. No branch was pushed and no code was written. The cloud developer session could not be launched from the maintainer's local session.

The maintainer's order, verbatim (2026-10-16): 「23904 你开不了云端会话就等车队处理」. This card returns to `pm:queue` at `priority:p0` for the fleet. It carries no `domain:*` yet: the refusal is `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (#23708) on the kernel's load path, so triage routes it. The body's Wanted and Acceptance stand: load-time refusals of retired declarations in installed or stored items become named warnings, authoring and publish still refuse, HotCRM 4.0.1's published bundle boots, and an ablation proves it.

**Downstream:** cloud's next pin bump carries the fix (objectstack-ai/cloud#2868). Production v18 waits on it, and on cloud#2868 round 11 for HotCRM's catalog-name conflict.

## Triage: P0 routed, `domain:spec` · `priority:p0` and `target:v18` stand · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T12:44Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **The lane is `domain:spec`.** The refusal `MisplacedDefaultPageError` is `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (`a69a40a572`, #23708), and the ADR-0087 transition pattern the card asks for is spec's. `packages/spec` belongs to the spec seat. The withdrawn claim `6215481679` read it the same way.
  - Where the kernel or metadata loader applies the check (`packages/core` / `packages/objectql` / `packages/metadata*`), the claim declares those files on the cross-domain exception path. ⛔ It does not split into a second card: one PR.
- **Why P0 stands:** the reach is measured. 10 of 36 staging environments are unserved, and production cannot take a framework pin that contains `a69a40a572` while its 5 demo environments hold HotCRM 4.0.1. The maintainer ordered 「相关任务都提到最高优先级」, and per `6215629596` the fleet now takes it: 「23904 你开不了云端会话就等车队处理」.
- **For the claiming seat:** `Clause-②: yes`, as the withdrawn claim declared (a load-time refusal becomes a named warning; the authoring and publish doors are unchanged).
  - If contract-first rules out any load-time tolerance, return `needs_decision` with the alternatives, as the card says. ⛔ Do not build one in that case.
  - Acceptance as written: HotCRM 4.0.1's published bundle boots with the named warning, the authoring door still refuses, and an ablation turns the boot red.
- **Downstream:** cloud's next pin bump carries the fix (objectstack-ai/cloud#2868).

Claim: PM loop round 14 (second shift, `priority:p0`, ahead of `batch 2`) · 2026-10-16T13:23Z · installed and stored pages carrying a declaration #23708 retired must not stop a kernel build; the authoring, save and publish doors keep refusing
Session: `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk` (the seat; the dev is a cloud session whose draft PR carries its own session link)
Account: `os-bill` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23904-installed-page-load-warning` (new; the withdrawn claim's `claude/issue-23904-load-tolerance` was never pushed and is not reused)
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23904`
Domain: `domain:spec` (triage `6215783095`); the engine files below are on the cross-domain exception path triage named, one PR
Seat: `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549)
File surface (paths on `origin/main` `11fea6b000` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: the two `MisplacedDefaultPageError` throws `a69a40a572` added (the package door `refuseDefaultRecordPageConflicts`, about `:2717`, and the per-item package registration, about `:4652`) and the error class beside them, only as far as the load-time path needs.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` and `packages/spec/src/ui/default-record-page.ts`: the three refusals `a69a40a572` added (`isDefault` off a bound record page, the closed `template` set with `full-width` retired, `checkPageRegionPlacement`), only where a load path applies them.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/**` and `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**`, only if the measured mechanism is an ADR-0087 load-path conversion entry.
- The stored-metadata and kernel-build paths that parse or register a page (`packages/metadata*`, `packages/core`), only where measurement shows the refusal fires there.
- Their tests, a fixture of HotCRM 4.0.1's published page shape, the liveness rows the change moves, generated artifacts through their generators, and one `.changeset/23904-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `content/docs/releases/**` or `.claude/**`. ⛔ Not HotCRM or cloud (their halves are objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2120 and objectstack-ai/cloud#2868).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (a cross-package load path proved by booting a kernel from a published bundle), `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (reason: the maintainer's own claim `6215481679` on this card set "top tier" for this P0; `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, Clause-② suspect on `packages/spec/src/**`). Review: a contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue, because the load door's accept set widens.
Clause-②: yes (a load-time refusal becomes a named warning; the authoring, save and publish doors are unchanged)
Responsibility: `a69a40a572` (#23708) is this repository's, landed by this seat | no platform path loads an installed package or stored page that predates it | every hosted environment with HotCRM 4.0.1 installed fails its kernel build: 10 of 36 staging environments measured, and the 5 production demo environments block the framework pin (card body)
Thread-read: 6215783095
Ruling-ref: the maintainer's words in the card body, quoted there: the option 「两条都做」 (framework half: "内核构建遇到已安装、已存储的旧元数据里被退役的声明时，按过渡窗口只警告、不拒绝启动；发布时照样拒") and 「相关任务都提到最高优先级」; in this seat's chat, 2026-10-16: 「23904 现在派」
Serial constraints cleared:
- `priority:p0` goes ahead of `batch 2`, on the maintainer's 「23904 现在派」. This seat's other two sessions (#22161 slices 18 and 19) have reported and are landing; they touch `packages/lint` only.
- All 16 open PRs' file lists were read in this act. None touches `page.zod.ts`, `default-record-page.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `packages/metadata*` or the kernel boot.
- In-flight #23543 (`os-elon-musk`, claim `6214417833`) edits one entry of `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` and the conversion suites. If this card's mechanism adds an entry there, the entries are disjoint and whichever lands second merges `main`. The P0 is not held for it.
